name: Late winter thaw
text: during the late winter thaw, softening snowbanks, ice breaking up on the river, dripping eaves, meltwater runnels, bare brown ground showing through

name: Sugaring season
text: in sugaring season, sap buckets hung on maple trunks, steam rising from a wooden sugar shack, old snow lingering in the woods

name: Mud season
text: in mud season, deep rutted dirt roads, brown puddles, flattened dead grass, bare trees, last gray snow in the shadows, {rubber boots|tractor tracks}

name: Early spring
text: in early spring, first green buds on bare branches, patches of melting snow, {crocuses|snowdrops} pushing through, cool fresh air

name: Spring plowing
text: in spring plowing season, freshly turned dark furrows, a tractor crossing the field, {gulls|crows} following the plow, leafless hedgerows

name: Budburst
text: at budburst, sticky buds splitting open, tiny crumpled leaves unfurling, catkins on {willow|hazel|birch} twigs, a faint green haze over the woods

name: Lambing season
text: in lambing season, newborn lambs beside their ewes, short fresh grass, dry stone walls, {daffodils|primroses} along the lane

name: Blossom time
text: at blossom time, orchards in full bloom, {white|pink} petals drifting down, bees in the flowering branches, petals scattered on the grass

name: Blossom festival
text: during a spring blossom festival, crowds strolling under flowering trees, picnic blankets on the grass, paper lanterns strung between branches

name: Spring
text: in spring, fresh green leaves, {cherry blossoms|wildflowers|apple blossoms}

name: Rice planting
text: in rice planting season, flooded paddies mirroring the sky, neat rows of young green seedlings, farmers wading knee-deep, muddy earthen dikes

name: Late spring
text: in late spring, lush deep green growth, full leafy canopy, {lilacs|wisteria|irises} in bloom, tall fresh grass, thick green hedges

name: Wildflower season
text: in wildflower season, meadows full of {lupines|daisies|cornflowers|buttercups}, buzzing bees, fluttering butterflies, knee-high grass

name: Early summer
text: in early summer, lush bright green foliage, {fields of poppies|blooming roses|tall green grass}, long sunny days, mild warm air

name: Haymaking season
text: in haymaking season, freshly cut hay drying in long rows, round bales across the fields, sweet smell of hay, {tractors|pitchforks}

name: Midnight sun
text: under the midnight sun, low golden sun skimming the horizon, endless daylight, green tundra, {northern fjords|arctic lakes|birch forests}

name: Midsummer
text: at midsummer, longest days of the year, meadows at full height, flower garlands, {elderflowers|wild roses} in bloom, warm lingering light

name: Berry season
text: in berry season, brambles heavy with ripe {blackberries|raspberries|blueberries}, baskets of fresh berries, stained fingers, sunny hedgerows

name: High summer
text: in high summer, deep green trees, blazing sun, dry golden grass, buzzing insects, warm heavy air

name: Rainy season
text: in the rainy season, swollen muddy rivers, puddled red dirt roads, dripping broad leaves, frogs in the ditches, damp heavy air

name: Monsoon greenery
text: in the monsoon season, emerald green hills, waterfalls on every slope, overflowing streams, moss on stone walls, glistening {tea gardens|banana groves|jungle canopy}

name: Late summer
text: in late summer, ripe wheat fields, sunflowers, dusty golden light, first dry leaves, warm hazy evenings

name: Golden dry season
text: in the dry season, sun-bleached golden hills, scattered dark oaks, dry creek beds, cracked earth, dust on the roadside, chirping cicadas

name: Harvest time
text: at harvest time, combine harvesters in golden fields, stubble and straw bales, {grain trucks|tractors with trailers}, dust drifting over the fields

name: Grape harvest
text: during the grape harvest, vineyard rows heavy with dark grapes, pickers with baskets, crates of bunches, vine leaves turning {yellow|red}

name: Early autumn
text: in early autumn, first yellow leaves among the green, ripe apples, {misty mornings|clear crisp afternoons}, cooling air

name: Bird migration
text: in migration season, long skeins of geese overhead, {cranes|swans} resting on stubble fields, reeds turning brown, thinning trees

name: Autumn
text: in autumn, golden and red leaves

name: Peak foliage
text: at peak foliage, hillsides ablaze with {scarlet|orange|gold} maples, colorful forest canopy, leaves carpeting the trails, cool dry air

name: Pumpkin season
text: in pumpkin season, orange pumpkins piled in the field, dried cornstalks, hay bales, {gourds|apple crates} at a farm stand

name: Late autumn
text: in late autumn, nearly bare trees, brown fallen leaves on the ground, gray damp sky, cold wet air

name: Tropical dry season
text: in the tropical dry season, leafless dry forest, red dusty earth, shrinking waterholes, flame-colored flowering trees, herds gathered at the water

name: First frost
text: after the first frost, white rime on the lawn, frosted fallen leaves, wilted garden plants, thin ice on puddles, cold clear air

name: First snow
text: after the first snow, a light white dusting over brown fields, snow resting on the last {yellow|red} leaves, fresh footprints

name: Winter
text: in winter, bare trees, cold pale light

name: Winter holiday lights
text: in the winter holiday season, string lights on houses and trees, glowing shop windows, {wreaths|garlands} on doors, snowy streets, festive market stalls

name: Polar night
text: in the polar night, sun never rising, deep blue twilight over snowfields, lit cabin windows, {northern lights|starry sky} above the frozen land

name: Hoarfrost
text: in hoarfrost season, bare trees coated in feathery white frost, every twig crystallized, frozen grass stems, still white fields

name: Frozen lakes
text: in midwinter on the frozen lake, thick ice, ice fishing huts, skaters on a cleared rink, snow-covered shores, {pine forest|reed beds} around the edge

name: Deep winter
text: in deep winter, thick snow covering everything, icicles, frozen still landscape, {pale blue|steel gray} sky, breath freezing in the air
